flags.sentence: Because the Health Care Act sets no legal maximum time for a cancer suspicion and Finland lacks national pathway monitoring, the team recommends reporting access times from referral to specialist visit, diagnosis and treatment start using THL guidance Ohjaus 21/2016 definitions (covering 16 cancers) and flagging stalled handovers while the STM roadmap (measure 3.1.2) plans national pathways by 2026–2028.
flags.problem: Overreaches the cited STM roadmap claims (q:ed87906241, q:0c7bf2dacb) by stating measure 3.1.2 plans national pathways by 2026–2028 without noting that the 2026–2028 target applies only to five unnamed cancers, while pathways for all significant cancers are planned for 2029–2031.
